v: What a movie!!!!! 🙏 Familiar love-story space ni so natural ga, sensitive ga chepparu. Characters, dialogues, little songs... everything feels lived, not acted. Repeat-watch list.
e: C/o Kancharapalem may share a broad emotional space with films like Naa Autograph, but its execution and sensitivity put it well above most comparisons for me. The local setting, first-time actors, natural dialogue and small situational songs create an experience that feels lived-in rather than manufactured — a classic for viewers open to this kind of cinema.
body:
To start with, thanks to Srikanth Dontharaju for inspiring/forcing me to watch this movie in theater……coming to the movie, what a movie, though it is inline with the concept of Naa Autograph and many others…..but execution and sensivity wise it is well above others.

with Vintage rural background and natural dialogues which create an everlasting impact…..a simple dialogue in which a prostitute say’s “Ipati dhaka nanu vasthavaaa anniadiginolle thappa…..premisthava anni adiginollu leeru raa” and a Boy gifting Condoms to his lover who is by profession a prostitute _/\_

Man there are many more such impactful scenes and dialogues!!!! and all the STAR cast acting for tye very first time adds more naturality to it!!! and wonderful short situational songs with loads and loads of meaning adds to the wonderful experiance.

Will be in repeated watchlist once its released in Amazon 🙂

PS : This classic is not for regular movie goers….so please dont watch if its not your gener and kill the soul of the movie with your negative feedback

v: Ranbir makeup lo 80% Sanju ayithe, acting lo 200% Sanju 🙏 Vicky కూడా superb. Hirani’s version of the story worked well for me as a father-son + friendship drama.
e: Sanju openly presents itself as Sanjay Dutt’s version of events, so I did not see the positive framing as something the film was hiding. By focusing mainly on addiction and the TADA case, Rajkumar Hirani finds enough material to explore the complicated father-son relationship, deep friendship and his familiar criticism of TRP-driven media, backed by an excellent cast.
body:
to start with, many ppl are commenting on the movie for showing Sanjay Dutt in positive light and that he was shown as if he was a victim!!!! I guess those intellectuals missed the very beginning scene of the movie, which clearly conves that the movie is Sanju’s version of the incidents

now coming to the movie……the plot of the movie focused only on the Drugs and TADA case on Dutt, However that was enough for Raj Kumar Hirani to briliantly convey the emotions and relation between a super star father and his spoil brat son and the emotional depth of friendship _/\_ and Hirani in his typical style conveyed his take on the Media which runs behind Breaking News!!!!

It was a perfect Star cast and the Vicky who played the role of Sanju’s best buddy put a steller performance and made audience to notice him rather than being shadowed with steller performances of Ranbir, Paresh & Manesha……

Make up wise, Ranbir Kappor’s resembeled 80% of Sanjay Dutt but acting wise he was 200% Sanjay esp during the days of Khalnaayak times!!! He put a steller performance especially for the Drug addict and rehab acts _/\_

The icing on the cake is Sanjay’s cameo in the rolling title song “Baba Bholtha hai bas ho gaya” which is a tight slap on the TRP hungry media!!!!

PS : I was very much dissapointed as there was no mention of RGV or Daud which was the first movie to release after Dutt’s release from Jail’s first term 😛

v: GOOD news: Pa. Ranjith didn’t change after Kabali. BAD news: exactly the same 😂 Rajini kosam vellina naaku mostly patience testే. Kabali itself felt better.
e: Kaala doubles down on Pa. Ranjith’s preferred style even though that approach had already frustrated me in Kabali. The film rarely feels like a Rajinikanth vehicle, the exaggerated supporting characterisations and recurring rap interventions became exhausting, and even Nana Patekar is given a generic role — for me, Kabali was considerably better.
body:
The GOOD thing is Pa Ranjith didnt try to change his way of story telling irrespective of Kabali’s debacle……..and the WORST thing is Pa Ranjith didnt try to change his way of story telling even after Kabali’s debacle!!!!

Rajni might have accepted the movie as the story might help him to connect with the masses and help him in his political carrer but he shouldnt have taken the decision to torture his Film Fans!!!

Barring 2 scenes this was never a Rajini’s movie…..many of previous Rajni’s movies had storng message with commercial elements which worked wonders for him…..but somehow Pa Ranjit was only concerend with his typical way of story telling and over the top charachterizations who test your patience _/\_

special mention of the RAP gang who always stay beside Kaala and perform RAP irrespective of the situation…..and they test your patience in couple of scenes where the RAP something like….”Kaala Kaala Kaala…..Manoolani champesaru Kaala….inkenthakalam ee mounam Kaala Kaala Kaala” and in another scene where trying to give condolence they again Rap “ammaa chala manchidi….amma chala manchidi”….hufff mee creativity ki oo dandam raa ayya

Nana Patekar was simply wasted in a generic role but he made sure his presence is felt…….Kaabali was far more better than Kaala….

v: I know I’m in the minority 😄 Officer worked for me. Realistic action, strong BGM, RGV angles and a vulnerable Nag... regular hero elevations expect cheyakunda chudandi.
e: Officer is deliberately far removed from conventional star cinema: Nagarjuna’s cop runs when survival demands it, there is no standard heroine track or hero-elevation package, the violence is harsh and RGV’s odd camera angles remain unapologetically his own. Those choices will alienate many viewers, but I liked the focused two-hour conflict, intelligent action design, BGM and several sharp dialogues.
body:
before I start my analysis of the film, I will try to analyze the reasons why it got so disastorus reviews/mouth talk:

1. rather than film being bad, Its more to do with RGV’s recent offscreen attitude which has rubbed many ppl on the wrong side, and they were hell bent in making this film a disaster even before its release (including so called reveiw writers)

2. the film is so realistic where hero being a cop runs for his life and waits for right moment, which doesnt gel well with the hero fans who want the hero to fight even 500 odd goondas irrespective of in which situation he is

3. the film has too much violance like chopping of a Kids finger, which doesnt suite the sensabilities of family and sensitive audience

4. RGV uses his weird camera angles which doest make a pleasent view for the normal audience who are accustomed to watch a movie in specific angle

Now coming to the movie, I have seen reviews complaining about No story in the film……My first question to them is were they busy sleeping in theater?? Movie is just 2 hrs long and covers the conflict of a Police Officer who is also a Mafia Gangleader and another Officer who is falsely accused as a Mafia leader…..well how much more story u need for a 2 hrs film???

Yes the movie is far away from commercial aspects where there is no heroine and no hero elevation scenes or dialogues……..but the movie is too real where the hero runs and the female lead has more gunshots than the hero _/\_ and though there are no hero elevation punch dialogues. there are thought provoking dialogues like :

oka vishayani artham chesukone mundhu……daani guda artham chesukovalsina vishayam okati undi anni guda artham kavali…..

1. jivitham lo nuvu entha ethu edhiginaa….neekaaana payna okkadu untadu anni epudu gurthupetuko

2. aadu chepina…ee nijam abadhamooo….ee abadham nijamo…manam kanipetali

3. Snehithulanni degarunchukovali……satruvalani marinyha degaraunchukovali

4. Prathi manashullo devudu rakshasudu idharu unttaaru

5. warnings isthu nenu time waste cheyanu……and the villan simply chops off a Kids finger with this simple dialogue _/\_

Yes, I agree that RGV should come out of this underworld and mafia stories but that is what he and Nag have said in each and every interview…….and as they promised it has one of the best BGM and realistic and intelligent action episodes (Beach episode, Essel World episode and whole Climax)

Just to conclude…..I might have loved this move because I am adarant fan of RGV and have his influence in the way I take pictures. However this movie was liked by my Wife nd my daughter equally, which shows that if you go with open mind…u have chances of liking this movie!!!!
